applies_to: THUD Synthetic_Scenes (Unity), 730x530 Depth/depth_N.png, checked on Office and Gym captures
saturated_meaning: at or beyond far_m; true distance unknown, treated as invalid

intrinsics.model: square-pixel pinhole from vertical field of view, principal point at image centre
intrinsics.camera_axes: x right, y up, z forward (Unity)
intrinsics.recorded_camera_intrinsic_in_metadata: NOT pixel units; do not use (fx 1013.89, fy 1520.83)

validation.summary: Back-projected instance-mask pixels lie inside the dataset 3D boxes: chairs 100% at 0 cm tolerance, desks 100% within 0.5 cm, all Gym classes >= 99.6% within 1 cm and 100% within 2 cm. Office sofa boxes do not enclose the whole sofa (consistent one-sided overhang), so sofa is excluded from the error estimate. Rejected: millimetres (0%), ray distance (25-42%), recorded intrinsics (6-16%).
validation.error_estimate: Combined depth + intrinsics error within about 2 cm over roughly 0.5-10 m on synthetic scenes, measured against Unity 3D boxes (which may themselves be slightly loose).

not_validated: Synthetic captures with other image sizes or camera settings
Any monocular or relative depth model output
